description:
T1 - Amelanchier, prune tips by 50cm to consolidate crown and help thicken it up, looks to be suffering from transportation stress.

T2 - Lime, remove regrowth to maintain current shape and prevent excessive growth with limited space. Removing 4 to 5m top regrowth back to pollard espalier form.

T1 - of 1m and height of 2m  Amelanchier, current canopy spread of 1m and height of 2m to prune tips by 50cm to consolidate crown and help thicken it up, looks to be suffering from transportation stress. Leaving canopy spread at 0.75m and height of 2m
T2 – Canopy spread 6m Heigh 8m Lime, current canopy spread 6m and height of 8m, remove regrowth to maintain current shape and prevent excessive growth with limited space. Removing 4 to 5m top regrowth back to pollard espalier form. Leaving canopy spread of 5m and height of 4m
decision_conditions: The specification is not suitable and therefore needs to be confirmed. The specification needs to be measurable and quantifiable so that we can understand the amount that is to be removed in meters. We need to know the amount to be removed and the remaining crown size. E.g. 2m crown reduction in width and 2m reduction in height, leaving a canopy spread of 3m and height of 5m
